label: Identification and traceability
description: Identification & Traceability covers animal identification and movement systems including RFID tags, ear tags, boluses, passports, microchips, tattoos, paint marks, leg bands, registration databases, and movement reporting. Supports disease control, food safety, trade, enforcement, and outbreak response through rapid tracing of animals, products, and contacts. Includes serious contagious disease monitoring and control for conditions such as Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD), Avian Influenza, African Swine Fever (ASF), Bovine Tuberculosis (bTB), Bluetongue, Scrapie, Classical Swine Fever, Newcastle Disease, Chronic Wasting Disease, Rabies, and other notifiable or transboundary diseases.
